verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board has stronger regional grouping and semantic color but loses finish through crowded or clipped corridor labels, several long detours, and tangled routing in the audit area.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four major sections occupy the frame effectively with useful outer margins, though the broad gap between the top and middle regions and uneven lower section widths create mild imbalance.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: FAIL: Nodes generally have air, but many white edge-label chips run behind or too near nodes, clipping phrases such as the top login sequence and crowding labels around provider integration and the audit flows.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Four clearly titled tinted regions provide strong functional grouping, with nested trust-boundary and audit annotations adding meaningful hierarchy.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, teal, purple, orange, green, and red are applied consistently enough to distinguish lifecycle families, success, expiry, and invalidation rather than serving as decoration.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: FAIL: No crosshair junctions are visible, but several arrowheads terminate awkwardly at bends or crowded joins, and the lower-right revocation wiring merges ambiguously around the invalidation and audit paths.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Major rows and section headers register well, but the spacious upper flow, sparse middle region, dense refresh block, and compressed audit block produce uneven visual rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: FAIL: Most local runs are readable, but the teal and purple cross-section marathons are long, while the orange and red routes in the audit area overlap, double back, and crowd multiple arrowheads.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the board under grade third at 6.5.
